blocks.text: After three years of living and pursuing her dreams in South Korea, Filipina singer and former UNIS member Gehlee Dangca is coming home to the Philippines on September 29 to embark on an exciting new chapter in her career—one that will see her pursuing opportunities both in the Philippines and on the international stage. Gehlee first captured international attention through Universe Ticket, the global survival program that formed the K-pop girl group UNIS. Her journey began when SBS approached Universal Records Philippines to scout Filipino talents for the competition. Among those who auditioned, Gehlee secured her place in the program and […]...
